Hymn 76: God of Our Fathers, We Come unto Thee
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Charles W. Penrose
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 76 titled "God of Our Fathers, We Come unto Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Charles W. Penrose.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
